title: #22 Inventions
prompt: In the past 100 years, there have been many inventions such as antibiotics, airplanes and computers. What do you think is the most important one? Why?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Inventions, such as antibiotics, have significantly improved human life by helping people live longer and healthier lives, preventing deaths from minor infections.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, inventions enhance communication, allowing people to connect with others far away, such as through computers sending quick messages.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, inventions enhance communication, allowing people to connect with others far away, such as through computers sending quick messages.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Inventions do not always make life better for everyone because they can cause physical problems.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology can create social problems by making people spend too much time on screens.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology can create social problems by making people spend too much time on screens.

angles.en: The essay argues that antibiotics and computers are the most important inventions of the last century.

angles.en: The essay argues that inventions have created new problems and reduced human skills, contradicting the idea that they have improved life overall.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
